messages.subject: Re: Problem related to scale_x_discrete, could you please help me?
parts:
Are you sure you have sent us the correct data?

For example, in your file I see three "abr's"
1 10.04.01 48 2010 4 abr
13 11.04.01 61 2011 4 abr
25 12.04.01 77 2012 4 abr

The one for 12.04.01 has a headcount value of 77 yet on your plot the value plotted is closer to 88.
The one for 11.04.01 has a headcount value of 61, yet on your plot the value plotted is closer to 72?

When I input your data and your functions I get basically the same plot as you, but the x-axis labels are very different. I believe the problem here is that your method of assigning month labels to the x-axis basically is taking the first twelve labels from your dataframe, it is not doing what you think it is doing. Accordingly, the highest value in your dataset is for ene 13.01.01 - and is 88, not for abr 2012 as your plot is showing.

Hope this provides enough clues for you to get back on track.

Wayne

On 13-Mar-17, at 15:17 , Alberto Otero García wrote:

Hello,

I want to plot a graph showing data by fiscal year. The problem I have is that ggplot is showing a point that does not exist in the data frame containing the information, and not painting another that really exists. Could you please masters of ggplot help me? Thank you very much!!

The code is:
plot = ggplot(data = headcountPerMonth,
              aes(x = Month.Number, 
                  y = Headcount, 
                  group = Fiscal.Year, 
                  colour = Fiscal.Year)) +
       geom_line() +    
       geom_point() +  
       labs(colour = "Fiscal year") +
       scale_x_discrete(
         name = "Month", 
         labels = headcountPerMonth$Month.Name
       ) +
       scale_y_continuous(name = "Headcount");
print(plot);

The plot is the next one. As you can see there is a value Month = March, Fiscal.Year = 2012, but not on Month = June, Fiscal.Year = 2012.

The data from the plot is the next one. As you can see there is no value Month = March, Fiscal.Year = 2012, but exists on Month = June, Fiscal.Year = 2012.
